title: cockpit: fix sudo login
reason: Applicable: real cockpit module + wired test (nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head 51ac5d673 contains 'cockpit = handleTest ./cockpit.nix {};'). Real diff adds a genuinely new `allowed-origins` mkOption declaration (type=listOf str, default=[]), wires it into `security.pam.services.cockpit.startSession = true;` (a real security-relevant fix, matching the PR title 'fix sudo login') and into `services.cockpit.settings.WebService.Origins`.
targets_toml: single target cockpit, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,cockpit], watch=[allowed-origins].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: A REAL, CORRECT transition at the per-verdict level: OptionNotFound at base (didn't exist) -> PredicateNotFound at head (genuinely exists now, correctly discovered via the ordinary nested options={...} declaration form, but has no predicate/branch tied to it -- its value is only used in a plain string concatenation, `builtins.concatStringsSep " " config.services.cockpit.allowed-origins`).

SECOND INSTANCE of the same rendering/categorization gap flagged in batch 2's PR 510900 (sshd moduliFile), this time in the OPPOSITE transition direction. raw.json's own summary is fully correct: changed=1, oba_verdict_transitions={'option_not_found->predicate_not_found': 1}. But summary.md's rendered table again shows ALL-ZERO across every named row (Unchanged: 0 included -- there is truly no row anywhere that represents this transition), and notable_total=0 / notable=[]. Per the coordinator's own naming convention introduced after batch 2, tagging this candidate_rendering_gap (detection succeeded -- the JSON correctly has the real transition -- but the human-facing summary renderer has no bucket for either *_not_found<->*_not_found transition direction, so a maintainer reading only summary.md would see nothing happened here either, despite a real option having been genuinely added).
